reference_sql:
WITH campaign_clicks AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
)
SELECT campaign_id, channel_id, clicks,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY clicks DESC) AS clicks_rank
FROM campaign_clicks
alternatives:
WITH campaign_clicks AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
)
SELECT cc.campaign_id, cc.channel_id, cc.clicks,
       1 + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_clicks cc2
            WHERE cc2.channel_id = cc.channel_id AND cc2.clicks > cc.clicks) AS clicks_rank
FROM campaign_clicks cc

WITH campaign_clicks AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.clicks) AS clicks
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
)
SELECT cc.campaign_id, cc.channel_id, cc.clicks, COUNT(cc2.campaign_id) + 1 AS clicks_rank
FROM campaign_clicks cc
LEFT JOIN campaign_clicks cc2 ON cc2.channel_id = cc.channel_id AND cc2.clicks > cc.clicks
GROUP BY cc.campaign_id, cc.channel_id, cc.clicks
